tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Book an appointment or consultation directly on Usama Sarwar's Google Calendar.

email.description: Email address to receive calendar invite and meeting link

agenda.description: Meeting discussion topics or project requirements

start.description: ISO start timestamp selected from an available slot (e.g. 2026-08-25T10:00:00.000Z)

end.description: ISO end timestamp selected from an available slot (e.g. 2026-08-25T10:30:00.000Z)

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Fetch real-time available 30-minute consultation booking slots grouped by day in a given timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Karachi', 'UTC'). Defaults to browser local timezone.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get Usama Sarwar's professional summary, engineering background, and AI specialization.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Get available engineering, consulting, and AI development services with pricing.

tools.name: get_social_links
tools.description: Get Usama Sarwar's verified social, code, and professional links.
